sources.summary: Cologix's JAX2 page gives the facility address as 4800 Spring Park Road, Jacksonville, Florida, and says 'Our JAX2 data center is in a hurricane-rated building housing the leading enterprise-grade data center and disaster recovery facility in Jacksonville'; customers choose JAX2 for its power density, infrastructure redundancy and disaster-recovery integration, and it is linked by dark fiber to the meet-me room at JAX1, 421 W. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service.

sources.title: QTS: Suwanee 1 data center campus page (version modified 2 October 2026)
sources.summary: QTS's Suwanee 1 page states that 'QTS's Suwanee, Georgia data center campus is home to some of our largest customers with 100+ MW current planned critical campus capacity in the north suburbs of Atlanta'. It lists 50+ MW critical campus capacity, a dedicated on-site substation, customer amenities (secure parking, break room, conference rooms) and the QTS Operations Support Center at 300 Satellite Boulevard, and its campus map and address block give DC1 at 300 Satellite Blvd NW and DC2 at 120 Satellite Blvd NW, Suwanee, GA 30024. A redundant campus fiber conduit system for future buildings is described as in progress. The statements about customers and on-site operations describe a campus in service; the 100+ MW figure is planned capacity.
